title: textured sprites
shortDescription: Textured 2D sprites with the TexturedSprites mesh, switchable between flat sprites and billboards
description: A `TexturedSprites` mesh with room for 256 sprites, built from a capacity and a texture; it creates its `TexturedSpritesGeometry` and `TexturedSpritesMaterial` itself. The sprites come from its `spritePool`, each one gets a frame of the `TileSet` through `setFrame()`, and `sprites.update()` uploads the changed buffers each frame. The button toggles `renderAsBillboards` on the material: as billboards the sprites turn towards the camera, as sprites they stay flat in their plane.
